d:
Two of India's most iconic singers, the Kalaastar Yo Yo Honey Singh and the best of Mika Singh, come together in a recreation of the classic Punjabi song Duma Dum Mast Kalander.
Singers: Mika Sing & Yo-Yo Honey Singh
Label: Times Music
Mixed & Mastered by: Vinod Verma
Duma Dum Mast Kalandar Lyrics:
Oh Ho, Oh Ho Ho
(O Laal Meri Pat Rakhio Bala Jhoole Laalan -2
Sindri Da, Sehvan Da Sakhi Shabaaz Kalandar
